loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
AutoCodeRover works in two stages:

- 🔎 Context retrieval: The LLM is provided with code search APIs to navigate the codebase and collect relevant context.
- 💊 Patch generation: The LLM tries to write a patch, based on retrieved context.
loop_primitives.note: Iterative code search = react; two fixed stages = fixed_pipeline; patch validation with retry = generate_test_repair (paper Sec. 1).

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The patch construction is then handled by another LLM agent which considers the buggy locations as well as all the context collected so far for those locations.
multi_agent_topology.note: Context-retrieval agent hands off to patching agent; SpecRover adds reproducer and reviewer agents.
